credential.title: Payment Credential
credential.description: Credential to tokenize. Handlers define accepted credential types in their specification.

type.description: The credential type discriminator. Specific schemas will constrain this to a constant value.

binding.title: Binding
binding.description: Resource this token is bound to. Ties the token to a specific capability resource.

type.title: Reverse Domain Name
type.description: The capability that owns the bound resource, for example dev.ucp.shopping.checkout. MUST be a capability name declared in the UCP namespace.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the bound resource within the owning capability, for example a checkout identifier.

identity.title: Payment Identity
identity.description: The participant this token is issued to. Required when acting on behalf of another participant, for example an agent tokenizing for a business. Omit when the authenticated caller is that participant.

access_token.description: Unique identifier for this participant, obtained during onboarding with the tokenizer.
